decisive_spans.text: Hematoxylin-eosin stained sections and CD56 immunostaining showing intravascular atypical cells

response.rationale: The vignette explicitly states 'Hematoxylin-eosin stained sections and CD56 immunostaining showing intravascular atypical cells', which directly supports Intravascular lymphoma (D3). While Extravasated intravascular large B-cell lymphoma (D9) also has this support, Intravascular lymphoma is a broader and more direct fit for the finding of intravascular atypical cells without further specification of extravasation in the provided text. Natural killer/T-cell lymphoma (D8) is supported only by a history of chronic pulmonary coccidiomycosis, which is not directly linked to the current skin findings. Systemic Infection (D7) is contradicted by negative blood cultures.
